scope: S2/S5 no-step reference preparation only; no training, physics stepping, root deployment, source-angle trimming, adhesion or model changes
primary: teacher actual physical BODY.npz 1112 frames, source_kind teacherderived_NOT_rawanimal
secondary: measured REFERENCE.npz first1112 of1176 frames, separately tagged; dt0.002 preserved, no retiming
registration: Fixed coxa anchors: forward=(LF+RF-LH-RH)/2; left=mean(LF,LH,LM)-mean(RF,RH,RM), projected perpendicular to forward; dorsal=cross(forward,left). Right-handed orthonormal frames C and S; source-to-current R=C*S^T, no reflection, translation represented by each current coxa anchor. Anatomical anterior/left assumptions, no external biological calibration.
landmarks: coxa,femur_center,tibia,tarsus1,tarsus2,tarsus3,tarsus4,claw_origin,material_foot. Front current femur center uses Trochanter, other legs Femur. Source claw capsule material surface point selected at lowest thorax-Z in key0, current Tarsus5 physical mesh vertex lowest thorax-Z in key0; each frozen body-local forever, not changing contact point.
geometry: Target cumulative chain follows registered source adjacent unit directions with eight current key0 inter-landmark lengths. Explicit current-native units SI NOT_ESTABLISHED. Orientation task uses eight adjacent directed unit vectors, deliberately no unobservable axial twist target. Distal flexibility mismatch retained in residuals.

solver.method: scipy least_squares trf exact analytic geometric Jacobian per leg, deterministic forward temporal pass
solver.initialization: key0 at frame0, previous solution thereafter; only one start
solver.hard_bounds: compiled joint ranges intersect previous targets +/-0.06rad for every adjacent .002s

holdout: Last222 frames are reported as temporal diagnostic holdout, no hyperparameter fitting; contiguous same-recording split does not establish biological generalization
failure_policy: Always preserve finite inbounds targets and unreachable residuals even quality gate failure; parent may run separate actual free-body physics diagnostic regardless
deployment: Only joint targets. First pose is initialization proposal; linearly interpolate2ms knots onto1ms actuator clock. PD128/rate30/native caps unchanged. Worldroot arrays privileged reference only. This is offline teacher-derived engineering supervision, not neural controller success.
counts: Count every explicit mj_forward/mj_kinematics/mj_comPos/mj_jac/reset and prohibit mj_step/mj_step1/mj_step2; compiler-internal calculations excluded
